title: "Meet the data"

## Bundled example

Use `data/metagenomics/example/` as the format reference for headers and table orientation.

## Your task — Add your own three files

Create or open `data/metagenomics/my-study/` from the repo root. Place these files directly inside it.

| File | What to enter |
|---|---|
| `taxon-abundance.tsv` | One row per sample and one column per taxon at a single rank. |
| `sample-metadata.tsv` | One row per sample with `sample_id` and `group`. |
| `functional-features.tsv` | One row per sample and one column per selected functional feature. Record the units and normalization. |

Use identical `sample_id` sets across all three files.

[Check your files](03-check-the-inputs.qmd).
